issue.title: Full text queries should not always ignore unmapped fields

labels.name: :Search/Search
labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Full text queries ignore unmapped fields since https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/41022
even if all fields in the query are unmapped. However queries that target unmapped fields only should not return result so for instance the `query_string`: `mapped_field:foo AND unmapped_field:bar` should not ignore the `unmapped_field` part of the query.
This change makes sure that we ignore unmapped fields only if they are mixed
with mapped fields and returns a MatchNoDocsQuery otherwise.

Closes #41022

body: IMO this is a bug so I opened https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/41062 to ensure that we ignore unmapped fields only if they are mixed in a disjunction with other mapped fields.
